title: Sparkly heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="heartGlow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff5c8a"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#e0245e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b0103a"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="shine" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd6e0" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffd6e0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Heart body -->
  <path d="M50 82
           C50 82, 18 60, 18 38
           C18 24, 30 16, 40 20
           C46 22, 50 28, 50 32
           C50 28, 54 22, 60 20
           C70 16, 82 24, 82 38
           C82 60, 50 82, 50 82 Z"
        fill="url(#heartGlow)"/>

  <!-- Lighter heart highlight edge -->
  <path d="M50 82
           C50 82, 18 60, 18 38
           C18 24, 30 16, 40 20
           C46 22, 50 28, 50 32
           C50 28, 54 22, 60 20
           C70 16, 82 24, 82 38
           C82 60, 50 82, 50 82 Z"
        fill="none" stroke="#ff8fb0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Glossy highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="35" rx="12" ry="9" fill="url(#shine)"/>

  <!-- Top-left sparkle (large star) -->
  <g fill="#ffe066" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="1">
    <path d="M22 14 L24 20 L30 22 L24 24 L22 30 L20 24 L14 22 L20 20 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top-right sparkle (medium) -->
  <g fill="#a0e7ff" stroke="#5cc8f0" stroke-width="1">
    <path d="M80 12 L81.5 16.5 L86 18 L81.5 19.5 L80 24 L78.5 19.5 L74 18 L78.5 16.5 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom-right sparkle (small) -->
  <g fill="#d4a5ff" stroke="#b47cf0" stroke-width="1">
    <path d="M76 72 L77 75 L80 76 L77 77 L76 80 L75 77 L72 76 L75 75 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom-left sparkle (tiny) -->
  <g fill="#ff9ecd" stroke="#f06aa8" stroke-width="0.8">
    <path d="M18 70 L19 72.5 L21.5 73.5 L19 74.5 L18 77 L17 74.5 L14.5 73.5 L17 72.5 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Mid sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx="85" cy="46" r="2.2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#a0e7ff"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="48" r="2" fill="#ff9ecd"/>
  <circle cx="9" cy="54" r="1.3" fill="#d4a5ff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="88" r="1.8" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="90" r="1.4" fill="#a0e7ff"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="85" r="1.6" fill="#ff9ecd"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="85" r="1.5" fill="#d4a5ff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="1.8" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="10" r="1.2" fill="#ff9ecd"/>
</svg>
